reason: Project lens: walk_column (src/game.6502 ~1998) is plain logic code in main RAM, not PROTECTED (grind_config PROTECT covers only irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242; PROTECT_BYTES only &0004-&001E), not generated, not raster-timed. The reorder only moves the d computation (LDA viewport_right_low/SEC/SBC mover_x_low/STA walk_d) ahead of the n-1 sum: X still = plot_sprite for LDA sprite_column_count,X (same bank 4 read under the same paging, plot_mover pages it in), Y = mover throughout, walk_d (&9D, walk_ptr+1, scratch) is written earlier but nothing between reads or aliases it (sprite_column_count,X and movers_x_low,Y are absolute indexed). TAX leaves A = n-1, so CMP walk_d sets C/Z exactly as CPX walk_d did. moved_on is reached only from the BCC (C=0) and from CLC/BEQ (C=0), A = n-1 on both, so dropping TXA leaves ADC mover_x_low identical; the n-1 > d path never reaches moved_on and is unchanged. No label is entered at an offset (grep for walk_column/moved_on/steps_known/walked/get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses +/- found none), no self-modifying operand inside. Shrinks by 1 byte so code after slides down 1: no data table is relocated by intent, everything is addressed by label, the page-crossing ASSERTs (e.g. keys at line 4474, add/subtract_Y_rows, move_mover_*) would fail the build if broken, and unused_3400_original's SKIP absorbs the byte so nothing from &3400 moves; the SKIP 13 above keeps walk_column's start where it was. Possible slowdown from branches after &1B63 crossing pages is a timing matter for the gate, as relies_on says. Same state, screen and sound on every path.
